reviews.text:
A huge thank you to Adeline for taking such good care of my cat 🥰 You can really tell she loves cats and does everything she can to make them feel comfortable.

I've been entrusting my cat to Adeline for almost a year now, and after each stay I regularly receive updates, with photos and videos, which is so nice to know when you're leaving your cat with her.

The cattery is spacious, clean, and designed with cats in mind: each cat has plenty of space, with food, water, hiding places, toys, cat trees, and high furniture for climbing or relaxing. The (secure) outdoor access is a real bonus for curious little ones!

Thank you again, Adeline, for your kindness and all the attention you give to the animals.

A 5-star hotel for... cats.

From the moment you arrive, you realize you're not just dealing with a cat lover, but a true animal welfare professional.

The area is very welcoming, with a large space equipped with activities, games, water fountains, and plenty of elevated spots accessible to our feline friends.

A second, quieter area is reserved for the "rooms," where each guest has their own personal space to settle in (for newcomers), or simply to hide, for the shy ones.

My cat, who is naturally very timid, loves spending time here, as long as, when it's time to pick him up... he's not in too much of a hurry to leave, as long as he loves being pampered and spoiled by the staff :)

This will soon be our fourth stay at this cattery, and we are delighted and leave our cat with complete confidence! Adeline or her replacement, Emilie, send us regular updates while we're away. Recently, our cat had a minor health issue during his stay, and he was treated with gentleness and professionalism.
The cattery is very well-equipped, full of toys, baskets, and platforms where the cats can climb, beautiful windows with a view… in short, it's a real vacation for our cat too :)
Thank you for your welcome and excellent care!
Thanks Emmanuelle for the feedback, I can't wait to see Tacos again 😻 …
I highly recommend the Devenir Un Cat cat boarding facility, which perfectly met our expectations. Don't hesitate to book for your next vacation.

Adeline welcomes our cats with great care every time we go on holiday. They're always thrilled to come back, and we get regular updates, which is a real pleasure. If you're looking for a reliable cattery, go for it! Our cats Ulysses and Wally highly recommend it 😸 …

I entrusted my two cats to Adeline with complete confidence. They immediately felt very comfortable in her presence. Adeline is a patient and reassuring professional. The updates via text message, complete with photos and videos, are a real bonus for a peaceful and serene holiday. I would entrust my beloved cats to her again without hesitation! A big thank you 🐾

Fantastic cat boarding! Adeline is a lovely person, passionate about animals, and she takes excellent care of them.

I left my cat Oslo at the boarding facility for two weeks in August. It went very well; he had plenty of cuddles and playtime. Adeline provides regular updates with short videos and photos. I was able to enjoy my trip, knowing he was being treated wonderfully. I highly recommend Devenir un cat!
Oslo will be back! 😻 Thanks again, Adeline! 😊

Tsuki was very well looked after and pampered by Adeline during his first stay at Devenir Cat! Adeline regularly sends photos and updates during his stay and even checks on the cat after he leaves :-)

Excellent cat boarding facility in Croix Rousse. The main room facing the street offers plenty of hiding places and toys (cat trees, high scratching posts, etc.), and the back room has individual enclosures for each cat. Very well maintained. Adeline provides fantastic personalized follow-up, sending photos every two days, and even a short message once the cat is back home. The cats roam freely around the boarding facility, which is great. The prices are reasonable for the location and service. Thank you again.

We use Adeline's services at Devenir un Cat several times a year and are always delighted and reassured.

Our two cats are usually timid, yet Adeline was able to reassure them and gain their trust from the very first meeting.
We regularly receive photos and always find them in great shape when we get home. We recommend her 10,000%!
Thank you, Adeline, for everything! 😻

What can I say?! I absolutely love it and highly recommend it. For a first 10-day stay, it was a real surprise and a success! My unweaned cat, despite being scared for two days, was transformed for the rest of his stay at this cattery where everything is done to make cats feel comfortable, whether they're playful or seeking peace and quiet.

They are respected and pampered. The setting is very pleasant, and updates on our little companions are given regularly during their stay. Adeline is so gentle and professional that my cat left even more affectionate and calm. Living in Villefranche-sur-Saône, this cattery is definitely worth the trip. My first impression was spot on, and I already know that I'll entrust my Löki to Devenir Un Cat without the slightest hesitation! And a huge thank you again!!

I recommend Adeline without hesitation. I was delighted to be able to entrust her with the care of my two cats. They were in excellent hands, and we heard from them every day.
Thank you for everything 🫶🏼😻 I would be happy to entrust them to you again!

I can only say thank you! A host who was incredibly attentive at all hours, a large living space where my cat could roam freely, an unbeatable price, daily photo/video updates, heartfelt care and affection, absolutely no stress... I can't express my gratitude enough! I would entrust my beloved cat to her without hesitation!

Adeline is a cat expert and will take excellent care of yours. It's a lovely space where cats feel comfortable. We're lucky to have a place like this in Croix-Rousse. The best part that makes all the difference: regular updates with photos and videos, for complete peace of mind 😻 …
Thanks Benjamin, give Carmen a scratch 😻 …

I highly recommend it!

It was the first time my cats had ever been to a cattery. They weren't used to it at first, but she did everything she could to make them feel comfortable.

As a result, they gave her lots of cuddles, and we picked them up so happy at the end of their stay.

They can't wait to go back for their next stay!

A perfect experience for Lucky with Adeline. For her first time at a cattery, everything went very well. Although not at all used to living with other cats and usually quite solitary, she had a wonderful stay: she ate normally and explored her new surroundings. I picked her up relaxed and in great shape! Thank you so much, Adeline!
It is with great pleasure that I entrust my little Lasco to Adeline! You can trust her with your cats without hesitation!

A fantastic first experience for our two babies! Adeline was amazing with them during our 15-day absence. Despite one of our cats being extremely shy, they enjoyed the experience perfectly. Adeline even managed to unlock a cuddle mode I've never experienced! A true feline magician!

Poupie (15 and a half years old) and Moon (1 and a half years old) had a wonderful Christmas holiday at the cattery. Adeline is attentive and caring; she adapts to each cat's personality and habits and always keeps their owners updated! For my two cats' very first time boarding, I felt completely reassured and now know exactly who to trust with my little tigers when I'm away. Another thing to mention: the cattery is spotlessly clean and full of climbing trees and various toys, which is sure to please both the shy and the playful ones 🥰. We'll definitely be back!!
Krystel, Poupie & Moon
Still as pleasant as ever. The cats are getting more and more settled in.

This is my second time staying at "Becoming a Cat" with Madame Adeline. She's very kind and gentle, and she takes great care of me and my friends. I love the place; it's clean, and there's unlimited cat food!!! (It's better than at home...), and lots of toys everywhere! I love it! I can climb the walls, and Madame Adeline plays with me and my buddies. It's great, and my mom doesn't pay much when she leaves me here. I'm a little scared when I first arrive, but after an hour, I feel right at home and I don't want to leave. Lilou - 6-month-old tabby cat. 😸

It was the first time our two cats, aged two and three, had been looked after by Adeline. This first experience was more than successful; they quickly took to Adeline, who is incredibly gentle, and her love for cats is truly evident. …

A first for our two cats, aged 3 and 8: a cat holiday camp!

I had excellent contact with Adeline beforehand, who showed me around the "Night …

I recently entrusted my cat to the "Devenir un Cat" cattery and I couldn't be happier with the experience. Poppy seemed so delighted with her stay that she didn't want me to take her back! Adeline was very attentive and created a warm and …

It was the first time I'd left my kitten Luna with someone, and everything went well. Adeline is very gentle. Luna, who is naturally reserved, quickly trusted her and was able to socialize and play with the other cats at the cattery. She also gave me regular updates, which was very reassuring.

First time at a group boarding facility for our Tigrou and we are absolutely delighted!
Adeline sent us photos/videos every two days, which was very reassuring!
We would definitely bring Tigrou back without hesitation.
Adeline is lovely and takes excellent care of our furry friends! I highly recommend her!
